title: Alderbrook POC — Security QA & Evidence Log
content:
Purpose:
This doc is the working evidence log and Q&A companion for the Alderbrook POC (payment orchestration customer). It combines: cleaned responses to their security questionnaire, mapping from requested controls to artifacts we can deliver, notes from the infosec workshop (2025-11-18), outstanding gaps, and an evidence collection timeline.

Scope and assumptions:
- Scope: Redwood-hosted inference for Alderbrook’s tokenization microservice + dedicated networking to their VPC (private deployment option evaluation).
- Data types in-scope: payment token IDs (pseudonymous), metadata, user IDs. No raw PAN is processed by Redwood; Alderbrook tokenization occurs upstream.
- Compliance targets discussed: SOC 2 readiness baseline + Alderbrook-specific checklist (encryption at rest & transit, KMS integration, audit logging retention 12 months, access review cadence).
- POC duration: Nov 6 — Dec 18, 2025 (deploy + security validation + go/no-go).

Questionnaire response summary (high-level):
- Authentication & Access: Redwood uses SSO with SCIM provisioning for org accounts + RBAC scoped roles. We propose an org-scoped service account for Alderbrook integration.
- Encryption: Data at rest encrypted with customer-managed KMS (optional) on Dedicated/Private. Transit uses TLS1.3 with mutual TLS for VPC peering paths.
- Logging & Monitoring: Token-level request logging retained in an ELK cluster for 90 days in POC; extended retention is an enterprise add-on. Audit logs available via secure S3 export (see artifacts).
- Data isolation: Dedicated GPU pool + tenant isolation + optional VPC peering.
- Incident response: Standard IR runbook + dedicated contact with 1-hr paging SLA for Sev 1 POC incidents.

Control-to-evidence mapping (what Alderbrook asked -> what we can deliver):
- A.1: Access reviews -> sample: access-review-2025-11.csv (owner: Priya Nair, link: s3://redwood-evidence/alderbrook/access-review-2025-11.csv)
- A.2: Provisioning/deprovisioning logs -> SCIM audit export (confluence:ALD-POC-Design-2025#scim-audit) + SCIM webhook delivery logs (artifact: jira:POC-578)
- E.1: Encryption keys -> KMS-policy-export.txt (owner: Luca Romano) + sample CMEK config for private deployment (artifact: s3://redwood-evidence/alderbrook/cmek-config.json)
- L.1: Audit logging retention -> ELK-index-snapshot-2025-11-18.json (owner: Jordan Li)
- S.1: Vulnerability management -> vuln-scan-summary-2025-11-10.pdf (internal svc vulnerability scans against POC image)

Available evidence artifacts (current):
- poc-deployment-manifest.md — high-level steps for private deployment (owner: Evan Brooks)
- cmek-config.json (example) — shows KMS ARNs and key policy snippets (owner: Luca Romano)
- s3://redwood-evidence/alderbrook/poc-logs.zip — redacted logs for three POC runs (contains request ids, latencies)
- access-review-2025-11.csv — list of human accounts with roles flagged for review (Priya Nair)
- vuln-scan-summary-2025-11-10.pdf — results of container image scanning (Maya Thompson)
- sec-workshop-notes-2025-11-18.txt — raw notes from the workshop, decisions and follow-ups (this doc also includes a cleaned section below)

Workshop notes — key decisions (2025-11-18):
- Alderbrook wants CMEK for all PII-like keys used in dedicated state stores; Redwood to provide a sample KMS policy and assisted setup. (owner: Luca)
- Retention: 12 months audit logs is acceptable — Redwood will provide S3 export automation in the POC. (owner: Jordan)
- Network: VPC peering + mTLS for control-plane RPCs. Alderbrook security team preferred mutual TLS over IP allowlist. (owner: Infra team, contact: Maya)
- Pen test scope: Alderbrook requests minimal external pen test focused on control-plane endpoints after initial rollout; Redwood will provide test window in week of Dec 8. (owner: Security, coordinate with Alderbrook security)

Gaps identified & proposed mitigations:
- Gap 1: Proof of encryption key separation for customer-managed keys during autoscaling operations.
  Mitigation: Create a short smoke test that performs key operations during scale-up and records KMS key usage metrics. Deliverable: kmstest-autoscale-run.log (owner: Luca, due: 2025-12-04).

- Gap 2: Access review cadence automation is not enabled for POC orgs by default.
  Mitigation: Provide a one-off access-review CSV and a runbook for how Alderbrook can enable periodic exports (owner: Priya, due: 2025-11-28).

- Gap 3: Evidence packaging for SOC-like audit — we need consistent manifests for each artifact (hash, owner, date).
  Mitigation: Build an evidence-manifest script to produce manifest.json for provided artifacts. Deliverable: evidence-manifest-v1.sh + sample manifest (owner: Evan, due: 2025-12-01).

Evidence collection timeline (milestones):
- 2025-11-18: Security workshop (done) — draft evidence list agreed
- 2025-11-25: Deliver initial artifact bundle (access reviews, KMS sample, logs snapshot) (target: done/in progress)
- 2025-12-01: Deliver evidence-manifest tooling + sample manifests
- 2025-12-08: Pen-test window begins (schedule with Alderbrook security)
- 2025-12-15: Final evidence package submitted for Alderbrook review

Meeting log (selected):
- 2025-11-06 kickoff (attendees: Evan, Priya, Alderbrook: S. Patel (sec), M. Ortiz (platform)) — agreed scope and data flows
- 2025-11-12 technical deep-dive (attendees: Luca, Jordan, Alderbrook infra) — discussed TLS, KMS options
- 2025-11-18 security workshop (attendees: whole list above + Alderbrook sec team) — decisions summarized above

Action items (short list):
- Priya: produce final access-review CSV + runbook (due 2025-11-28)
- Luca: provide CMEK key policy sample + run autoscale kmstest, upload kmstest-autoscale-run.log (due 2025-12-04)
- Jordan: generate ELK snapshot export for 90-day index + provide S3 export playbook (due 2025-11-25)
- Evan: finish evidence-manifest script and upload sample manifests to s3 (due 2025-12-01)
- Maya / Infra: schedule pen-test window and confirm scope with Alderbrook (target schedule by 2025-11-30)

Open questions for Alderbrook (waiting on customer reply):
- Confirm whether Alderbrook requires HSM-backed keys (true HSM) vs cloud-KMS CMEK for POC.
- Finalize list of technical contacts and pager escalation chain for the pen-test window.

Next steps (for internal owners):
- Owners to drop artifacts into s3 path above, add checksums to evidence-manifest.
- Schedule one follow-up sync 2025-11-26 to confirm delivered artifacts and remaining gaps.

Attachments (listed here; actual artifacts uploaded to s3 / linked_artifacts):
- sec-workshop-notes-2025-11-18.txt (raw meeting notes)
- access-review-2025-11.csv
- cmek-config.json (example)

Notes to reviewer: this is a living doc. Keep edits as incremental comments; once all artifacts are present and manifests created we will convert status->final and produce a packaged PDF for Alderbrook’s audit team.

[end of document]
